title: The Nativity Fast: the Church's own readings of the Nativity

review.basis: The owner's pick of 2026-11-07: the prophecies and Gospels the Church herself reads at the Nativity, each day saying which service it is from. Every reference is as data/calendar/official-readings.json gives it (the Orthodox Church in America's daily readings, 2026-12-13, 12-19, 12-20, 12-24, 12-25 and 12-26), and so is every service, except that the data gives the Epistle and Gospel of 2026-12-13 without naming the Sunday of the Holy Forefathers; in the order of the services, each passage once, at its first reading. The day notes say only where it is read; the questions (data/plans/guide/en.json, nativity) are the editorials' and await review.
